dataAnnotation.title: Data Annotation Services
dataAnnotation.description: High-quality data annotation and labeling services for AI and machine learning. Image, video, text, audio, and LiDAR annotation by expert teams.
dataAnnotation.heroH1: Professional Data Annotation for AI & Machine Learning
dataAnnotation.overviewText: Loopernode provides enterprise-grade data annotation services that power the world's most advanced AI models. Our expert annotators deliver precise, scalable labeling across images, video, text, audio, and 3D point clouds.
dataAnnotation.imageAnnotationDesc: Bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, polygon annotation, and keypoint detection for computer vision models.
dataAnnotation.videoAnnotationDesc: Frame-by-frame object tracking, action recognition, temporal segmentation, and video classification for autonomous systems.
dataAnnotation.textAnnotationDesc: Named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, intent classification, and text categorization for natural language processing.
dataAnnotation.audioAnnotationDesc: Speech transcription, speaker diarization, emotion detection, keyword spotting, and acoustic event classification.
dataAnnotation.lidarAnnotationDesc: 3D bounding boxes, point cloud segmentation, and lane marking for autonomous vehicle and robotics applications.
